visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a blue Polo cap and gold-rimmed glasses sits at a dark automatic Mahjong table. His arms are covered in tattoos. Behind him is a wall with yellow and white soundproofing foam. He watches as the tiles are shuffled. (2) Opposite him, a woman with long, silver-grey hair and a light beige t-shirt is visible. She reaches out with both hands to organize a wall of white Mahjong tiles. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (3) Close-up on the man's hands as he picks up a tile. He has a gold watch on his left wrist. He looks down at his hand of tiles, appearing disappointed or frustrated, his mouth forming a slight frown. (4) The camera shifts to a close-up of the woman's hand revealing a winning set. She flips over the long row of tiles in one fluid motion. Yellow captions appear at the bottom of the screen. (5) The man leans forward, his eyes wide in surprise behind his glasses. He points at the woman's tiles while talking. The woman rests her chin on her hand, looking smugly at the man across the table. (6) A new scene shows the woman pointing at specific tiles on the table, explaining the scoring. She has long, dark fingernails. The man's hands are visible on the edge of the table, moving slightly as he listens. (7) A hand enters from the right side of the frame, holding a beige T-shirt with a large dog print on it. The man takes the shirt and holds it up to his chest, smiling towards the camera. (8) The man is now wearing the beige dog T-shirt. He is holding a small stack of green Mahjong tiles in his hands. He looks at the camera and speaks while the woman sits in the background. (9) Both players draw a single tile from the automatic table's center well to compare. The woman draws a tile and looks at it, then smiles broadly at the man. The man looks at his tile and laughs. (10) The screen turns black and white with a large text overlay in Traditional Chinese. The woman is seen waving her hand in a friendly goodbye gesture as the video concludes.
